duration: Most positions ask for a 6 month minimum commitment
name: Youth Volunteer at Dane County Humane Society
what_you_do: Youth volunteers help care for and comfort animals at the shelter, do service projects, or help in other ways. Most positions are a weekly 2 to 3 hour shift.
who_can_apply: Ages 8 to 17 with a parent or guardian permission. Ages 13 to 17 may volunteer solo, but openings are limited. Younger kids must come with an adult.
deadline_text: No deadline. Most weekend and after-school youth shifts are currently full, and there is no waitlist.
how_to_apply: Read the youth volunteer page, check current openings for youth positions, and sign up through the shelter volunteer process. The shelter can give a letter of completion for school service hours after six months.
notes: Shifts for ages 8 to 17 fill up quickly. The page lists other ways to help for teens who cannot do a six month shift.
